analysis: The method `getPageTitle` takes a WebDriver object and calls `driver.findElement(By.id("kc-page-title"))` to locate an element, then calls `.getText()` on that element. The `findElement` method may throw `NoSuchElementException` if the element is not found, and `getText` may throw `StaleElementReferenceException` if the element becomes stale. Both are runtime exceptions. The code currently does not catch any exceptions. Although runtime exceptions are not required to be caught, failing to handle them can cause the method to throw unhandled exceptions to the caller. To improve robustness, it is advisable to catch these specific runtime exceptions within the method and return a default value (e.g., null) instead of propagating the exception.
